data.case_title: Debt Collection Demand for Unpaid Internet Invoices
data.summary: Inkassobüro Beispielrecht GmbH, acting on behalf of Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH, demands payment of €131.48 for unpaid internet invoices from August and September 2026 (main claim, a creditor's reminder fee and collection costs), to be paid by 2 December 2026.
data.explanation: A debt collection agency (Inkassobüro) is pursuing unpaid internet bills on behalf of your provider. The total of €131.48 covers the two unpaid invoices, a reminder fee charged by the provider, and the agency's own collection fee. Pay the full amount to the trust account shown by the stated date to stop further steps. If you believe the claim is wrong (e.g. you already paid, or dispute the amount), write to the agency explaining why — they say they will then check this with the provider. This is a private collection letter, not a court order, but ignoring it can lead to further costs or legal action, so act promptly or seek advice if unsure.

key_facts.label: Payment deadline
key_facts.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.

items.title: Pay the debt collection claim
items.action: Transfer the full amount of €131.48 to the agency's trust account (Treuhandkonto) using the IBAN shown.
items.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.

items.title: Dispute the claim if you disagree
items.action: If you think the claim is wrong, write to the collection agency and explain your reasons.
items.quote: Wenn Sie die Forderung bestreiten, teilen Sie uns das bitte mit Begründung mit; wir klären den Sachverhalt dann mit unserer Auftraggeberin.
